ideas.pitch: An AI-powered automated coordinator for corporate or friend group Secret Santa gifting that matches participants based on deep preference profiling and auto-negotiates delivery constraints.
ideas.title: SecretSantaAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the core challenge of getting real users onboarded and active before Christmas by tapping into live holiday workflows and social graphs.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent seasonal recipe assistant that scans leftover holiday groceries using computer vision and crafts custom festive menus with real-time dietary adaptation.
ideas.title: HolidayMenuAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of creating a concrete, highly functional consumer utility with immediate viral potential during the December holidays.

ideas.pitch: A Chrome extension that lets users chat with online retail wishlists to find deals, cross-reference gift recipients, and surface hidden holiday discounts in real-time.
ideas.title: FestiveWishlistChat
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven browser-extension chat format that won previous product hackathons, making adoption frictionless for real users testing it during the 7-day shipping window.

ideas.pitch: An AI agent that matches holiday donors with hyper-local Bengaluru NGOs and community causes based on real-time inventory needs and geographical proximity.
ideas.title: ChristmasCharityMatch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emphasizes clear, measurable social impact and community engagement—critical vectors for winning hackathons focused on live user adoption.

ideas.pitch: A generative multi-modal platform that produces personalized, emotionally resonant holiday greeting videos and audio messages in regional Indian languages.
ideas.title: XmasCardAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on localized multimedia content generation which drives high engagement and instant social sharing among real users during the December festival season.
